summary.note: This document analyzes current dependencies to inform the extraction process. Actual changes will be made in subsequent steps.

potential_improvements.improvement: Consider extracting these queries to canonical financial services if they represent universally used calculations
potential_improvements.rationale: While the queries are correct, centralizing complex financial queries improves maintainability and consistency

potential_improvements.improvement: Consider encapsulating DB queries in repository classes for better testability
potential_improvements.rationale: Direct DB facade usage makes unit testing more difficult

accepted_violations.rationale: ReportService appropriately aggregates data from multiple specialized services to provide comprehensive reports. This is the correct use of a reporting service.

verification.controller_to_service_layering: confirmed - all controllers delegate to services
verification.service_to_model_usage: confirmed - services use models directly for data access which is acceptable in Laravel
verification.no_domain_to_infrastructure_leaks: verified - no direct HTTP, Mail, Storage usage found in reporting services
